subject.title: improve(gateway): bound visible history page reads

question: Should `/sessions/:sessionKey/history` adopt opaque generation-aware continuation cursors now, and what explicit support and retirement policy applies to existing numeric cursors?
rationale: The implementation changes a gateway response contract rather than only an internal storage detail; its stated “one upgrade window” does not identify the supported version boundary or client migration expectation.

options.title: Adopt a documented cursor transition
options.body: Keep opaque generation-aware cursors, define the numeric-cursor support window and reset behavior, and land only after exact-head HTTP/SSE proof.

options.title: Defer the cursor format change
options.body: Keep the current numeric public cursor contract and pursue bounded reads behind a compatible or separately versioned gateway API design.

recommendation.title: Adopt a documented cursor transition
recommendation.body: Keep opaque generation-aware cursors, define the numeric-cursor support window and reset behavior, and land only after exact-head HTTP/SSE proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current active-projection and bounded-history foundation that this PR extends.
